text_block_list.text:
One day, as adjustments for the Niigata 
Daishoten were steadily underway...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer! Pokke-chan is—

News came rushing in that Jungle Pocket 
had gone on a break to recuperate.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I told you, I'm totally fiiiine!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Not really... It's not like I'm taking an 
indefinite hiatus like Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
What about the Takarazuka Kinen, 
though...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
It's impossible. The overseas campaign is 
down the drain too.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I told you, it ain't over! I haven't 
given up on becoming the strongest, you 
know!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Dants. Wipe that mopey look off 
your face."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I realized something during our Classic 
Year. Whenever it comes to being the 'lead 
role,' you completely fly off the handle."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
That's why she never wavers. That's why 
she's so strong.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat stuff like this either. You 
just keep charging straight down your own 
path.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
So—you better be ready when I make my 
comeback! Got it?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Pokke-chan...

Shaken to the core by Jungle Pocket's 
setback, the time came to take on the 
Niigata Daishoten—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I have to switch gears! Today's the 
all-important Niigata Daishoten, after 
all.
choice_data_list:
For now, let's just focus on what's right 
in front of us.

text_block_list.text:
"What happened to Jungle Pocket is 
unfortunate. However, that doesn't mean 
Dantsu Flame's path has been cut off."

"If anything, there's plenty we need to do 
starting from here on out."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes. I will walk my own path—

Jungle Pocket had said it plainly as well: 
Dantsu Flame is "freakin' strong."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...You're right.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Before my debut, I never would have 
thought people would say things like that 
to me."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I have to do what needs to be done. 
For the day we can run together again, 
too...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: All right, time to do my best in Niigata!

"Taking a powerful step forward— The 
curtain rises on the Niigata Daishoten!"
